failure_stage: MMFU_Single seed 0, sample index 72 (css_03), after 71 accepted immutable units
root_cause: The tensor-parallel Qwen3-VL visual encoder required one additional 398 MiB allocation while each 24 GiB chat GPU had only 101.62 MiB free under CHAT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.95. The vLLM EngineCore terminated with CUDA out of memory, so subsequent answer and judge calls lost their endpoint.
operator_action: After the chat service had already exited, the exact project-owned css_03 worker was terminated so the frozen unit, scheduler, and controller EXIT traps could seal the failure and stop the two remaining project embedding services.
scientific_impact: No Wave1 seed or method result is accepted. The 71 successful unit roots and one rejected unit remain diagnostic evidence only and are never mixed with recovery2.
authorized_recovery: First rerun only css_03 under the otherwise identical stack with CHAT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION reduced from 0.95 to 0.90. Only after that capability root is terminal-accepted may the complete 4-method by 3-seed Wave1 run restart from the first unit in entirely fresh roots.
